title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows, improve caching and hygiene
author: Aisha Patel
description: Context: Our monolithic CI workflow has grown large and slow; teams see long queue times and cache misses. This PR splits the monorepo CI into three focused workflows (lint, test, release), consolidates reusable caching logic, upgrades selective devDependencies for faster installs, and adds hygiene checks to reduce flakiness. Motivation: faster feedback for engineers, smaller job surfaces for caching, and clearer separation of concerns between presubmit checks and release automation. Changes include: split lint jobs per package group; move slow integration-style tests to an opt-in matrix; reduce runner footprint for lint-only PRs; introduce a shared cache action wrapper to normalize cache keys and improve hit rate; bump actions/setup-node and restore-across-jobs to address cache key collisions. Checklist: [x] split workflows and basic smoke runs, [x] implement shared cache helper, [x] update package devDeps (eslint, typescript, prettier) with compatibility tests, [x] add repository-level lint presubmit gating, [x] update release workflow to be idempotent and add release tagempotency guard. Related: ENG-4821 (CI perf), ENG-4902 (release automation hygiene). Testing: ran full pipeline nightly on branch and iterated on flaky cases. No behavior-level product changes.
